definitions.explanation: To reach a state of being fully cooked in liquid.

notes:
{煮|に}える describes food reaching a state of being fully cooked in boiling liquid.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: {自動詞|じどうし} (intransitive)
- Pair: {煮|に}る (transitive, to cook/boil something)

ASPECT (ている):
{煮|に}えている means 'is cooked/done' (resulting state). Example: {野菜|やさい}が{煮|に}えている (the vegetables are cooked).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {野菜|やさい}が{煮|に}える: vegetables get cooked
- よく{煮|に}える: to cook thoroughly
- まだ{煮|に}えていない: not cooked yet

IDIOMS:
- {煮|に}ても{焼|や}いても{食|く}えない: someone impossible to deal with (lit. 'can't eat whether boiled or grilled')
- {業|ごう}を{煮|に}やす: to lose patience
